signals.text: Revenue grew 17% a year over 3 years vs 23% over 5: growth is slowing.
Profit compounded at 8% vs revenue at 17%: profits are lagging sales.
Operating margin compressed 95 bps in 3 years (8.5% → 7.5%).
Over 5 years, operating cash flow was 105% of reported profit: profits are turning into cash.
Free cash flow was negative in 3 of the last 5 years: capex is running ahead of cash generation.
